_about: What a telemetry judge must notice (contract/telemetry/v1/protocol.md). Each case applies `change` to fixture.json's exports, in order: `empty` drops everything; `resource` drops or sets an attribute on every Resource; `span` on every span whose name starts with `match`; `spans` on every span; `metric` changes an instrument's unit. Values are OTLP/JSON AnyValues. `expect` is `passed`, or the one check that must fail — and a `note` the report must carry.
